profiles.name: Shottr
profiles.why: Shottr and CleanShot both market scrolling capture, OCR and annotation as core features ('Take a screenshot of a long web page or capture conversation in a chat' vs CleanShot's 'Capture full pages, long chats, documents, and code that stretch beyond your screen'), but Shottr's one-time Basic Tier is $12 versus CleanShot Basic's $35 one-time price, and Shottr additionally offers an indefinite free tier while CleanShot offers no trial, only a 30-day money-back guarantee. CleanShot's $35 purchase also includes only one year of free updates before an optional $19/seat/year renewal, a recurring-cost element Shottr's pages do not describe for its own license.
profiles.discovery_reason: The cheap/free closest-alternative a buyer compares against before paying for CleanShot's subscription-like one-time price, since it covers scrolling capture, OCR, and annotation.
profiles.one_liner: Shottr is a tiny and fast mac screenshot tool with annotations, beautiful backgrounds, scrolling screenshots and S3 upload capabilities. Built with love and optimized for Apple silicon.
profiles.promise: Shottr is designed to be the lightweight, fast screenshot tool — tiny on disk and near-instant to use — while still covering annotation, scrolling capture and upload.
profiles.pricing: Free tier (full download, nagged to upgrade after ~30 days); Basic Tier one-time purchase 'Buy for $12'; Friends Club one-time purchase 'Join for $30'; an optional 'Pay what you want' option including $0.
profiles.free_entry: Free, full download usable indefinitely: 'You can download and use Shottr for free. After 30 days it will start asking you to consider upgrading.' A 'Pay what you want' option also lets someone enter $0.
profiles.icp: Screenshot tool for designers, front-end engineers, mobile developers, those who care about pixels
profiles.note: 4 claim(s) the extractor reported were not on their pages and were discarded
